name: watt
description: Shows how long each tool call took, and per turn: tool call count, time waiting on the model, time running commands.

keepSeconds.title: Finished agents stay (seconds)
keepSeconds.description: How long a finished subagent's chip stays in the agent row, until its × is pressed

twinkle.title: Twinkle the pixel fill
twinkle.description: Animate the dots of the summary fill. Off, they are drawn still

sounds.title: Play a sound when work ends
sounds.description: A soft sound when a main turn of 30s or more ends and when all running subagents finish; the error one when it failed

showModel.title: Show the model on each chip
showModel.description: The model each subagent runs on, dimmed beside its time; dropped first when a chip is narrow
